```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
df <- params$data
```

## Overview Report

### Generated By: `r params$name` 

---

## Filters Applied

```{r}
if (nrow(df) == 0) {
  cat("No data selected. Please adjust filters in the Shiny app.")
} else {
  cat("**Region(s):**", paste(unique(df$Region), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  cat("**Gender(s):**", paste(unique(df$Gender), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  cat("**Age Range:**", min(df$Age), "-", max(df$Age), "\n\n")
  cat("**Purchases Range:**", min(df$Previous_Purchases), "-", max(df$Previous_Purchases), "\n\n")
}
```

---

## Conversion Rate by Campaign

```{r, eval = nrow(df) > 0}
df %>%
  group_by(Campaign_Exposure) %>%
  summarise(Conversion = mean(Purchase_Made)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Campaign_Exposure, y = Conversion, fill = Campaign_Exposure)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Conversion Rate by Campaign", y = "Conversion Rate") +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## Total Amount Spend by Region

```{r, eval = nrow(df) > 0}
df %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarise(TotalSpent = sum(Amount_Spent)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Region, y = TotalSpent, fill = Region)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Total Spend by Region") +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## Income vs Amount Spent

```{r, eval = nrow(df) > 0}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Income, y = Amount_Spent, color = factor(Purchase_Made))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Income vs Amount Spent", color = "Purchase Made") +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## Summary Table
#### for some variables

```{r, eval = nrow(df) > 0}
tb<-df %>%
    select(Age, Income, Previous_Purchases, Amount_Spent) %>%
    summary() 

kbl(tb) %>% kable_classic()

```
